scope: Create one isolated Event function and invoke only its fixed read cases after source/package-bound owner approval. No producer/admin invocation or production cutover.
package_config: Replace embedded deployment config with empty triggers and no environment values; keep API implementation, common, SDK and RELEASE_SOURCE.json identical to the independently verified D-016 package. Environment/role snapshot stays private and is separately fingerprinted.
rollback: No production route points at this function. On failed verification stop calls and retain diagnostics; deletion/cleanup is a separate explicit action. Never delete or recreate an existing production function.
